name: v51-m3-spec-first
note: Control vs one targeted data intervention. Phase 2 found that most unseen-task failures are task interpretation errors: the code of a neighbouring trained function with the one word that differs ignored (fourth_item -> items[4], first_three_chars -> s[:2], longest_word -> min). Treatment B changes only the answer format of the existing verified write examples: each written function starts with a docstring restating the task from the prompt, then the same code (basics.SPEC_FIRST). Same checkpoint (round 54), token budget (72 steps x 4 x 1024 packed tokens), optimizer (Lion, lr 1.5e-5, WSD schedule), layers (top 24), evaluation and matched seeds. Skill functions off in both arms. Decision metric: unseen_clean = clean dev (/44) + unseen-concept set (/53).
